summary: Use GetNoCache for polling and for the approval triage queue.
reason: Both commands read volatile state through the client response cache. gate --wait polled the same URL and got the cached pending body forever, reporting a run the server finished in seconds as still running. approvals showed a request as pending after it had been rejected.
validated_outcome: gate --wait now completes in ~16s against a real eval run; approvals reflects a rejection immediately.
